description: This PHP source file provides an Oracle database driver implementation via ODBC for the ADOdb database abstraction library. It defines classes for database connection and recordset handling specific to Oracle using ODBC, including methods for retrieving metadata such as tables and columns, and establishing connections.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc_oracle
classes.description: Represents an ODBC-based Oracle database driver, provides methods for retrieving table and column metadata, and managing database connections.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc_oracle
classes.description: Handles recordsets for the ODBC Oracle driver, extending the base ODBC recordset class.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves the list of table names from the Oracle database via ODBC.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves the column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a new database connection using ODBC with provided DSN, username, and password.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent database connection using ODBC.
